The '''Daruvvia system''' was located in the [[Lorelli Reach]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Lorell Route]] to the [[Ket system/Legends|Ket]] and [[Sennex system/Legends|Sennex systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Daruvvia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[vhork]]s<ref name="Apocalypse" /> and was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Daruvvian champagne]].<ref name="501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Daruvvian champagne]]|system=Daruvvia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Daruvvia system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
